bugs_found.description: build_okx_daily_panel() used resample('D').sum() to build OKX daily panel, but k287_satellite_run.py compute_k275_daily_pnl() expected daily MEAN and applies *3 (K275_EVENTS_DAY). This would cause 3x overcounting for any day written by the fetch script. Current panel was safe (built with .mean() from backtest), but first incremental fetch run would corrupt new days.
bugs_found.fix: Changed .sum() to .mean() on line 420. Updated comments to clarify convention.
